notes: Native file transcription and translation use multipart requests. Response format and timestamps are passed to the upstream; the proxy does not transcode input audio.
OpenAI pricing is per minute, not per token. This card does not assume the same price or availability on Azure OpenAI.

contextWindow, maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens remain independently unverified for this exact deployment/endpoint. No token ceiling is inferred from a sibling model, billing unit, or subtraction of other limits.
modelVersion has not been independently verified as an exact deployment snapshot; the stable model ID is retained rather than inventing a release date or copying a sibling version.
